Title: Looking for an accountability partner to stay off social media until the end of 2026
I recently started a social media break with someone I met here, and we managed to keep it going for almost two weeks. Unfortunately, they had to step away from the challenge, but I’m still motivated to continue.
Taking a break from social media has been a great experience, and I want to keep going until the end of 2026. I’m looking for someone who’s serious about doing this with me. We can start with 10 days and keep each other accountable through the end of the year.
If you’re interested, feel free to reach out!
